test_name: Verify RoostGPT Configuration with Valid Inputs
description: This test verifies that a user can successfully configure the RoostGPT platform with valid inputs, including setting tokens, selecting repository types, and saving the configuration.
steps: Click on the 'RoostGPT Config' link in the navigation bar.
Verify that the Roost Token input field is displayed.
Enter a valid Roost Token in the input field with stable selector '[data-testid="test-name-input"]'.
Enter a valid OpenAI Token in the input field with stable selector '[data-testid="openai-token"]'.
Click the 'Unmask' button to verify the OpenAI Token value entered.
Select the 'Cloud' option in the Git type radio button group using '[data-testid="cloud-git-type-radio-button-selected"]'.
Enter a valid GitHub source token in the input field with stable selector '[data-testid="github-source-token"]'.
Click the 'Unmask' button to verify the GitHub source token value entered.
Check the 'Traverse to all sub-directories' option using the label with stable selector '//div[@id="advanced"]/div[2]/div[4]/div[2]/div/div/label'.
Check the 'Check for Vulnerability' option using the label with stable selector '//div[@id="advanced"]/div[2]/div[5]/div[2]/div/div/label'.
Enter a valid value for custom functions to test in the input field with stable selector '[data-testid="functions-to-test"]'.
Verify that a success message is displayed confirming the configuration was saved.
expected_results: The user is able to navigate to the RoostGPT Config page.
The Roost Token and OpenAI Token fields are editable.
The 'Cloud' Git type option is selected by default.
The user is able to check additional options like 'Traverse to all sub-directories' and 'Check for Vulnerability'.
Configuration changes are successfully saved, and a success message is displayed.
edge_cases: What happens if the Roost Token is left empty?
What happens if an invalid OpenAI Token is entered?
What if the 'Save Configuration' button is clicked without selecting any Git type?
What happens if the GitHub source token is invalid?
What if the user tries to save without checking any advanced options?
data_requirements: A test function name to input in '[data-testid="functions-to-test"]'.
Custom configuration data for advanced options.
dependencies: The RoostGPT Config page must be accessible.
The user must have valid tokens for OpenAI and GitHub.
The 'Save Configuration' backend API must be functional.
api_interactions: POST request to save the configuration data.
Fetch request to load existing configuration data on page load.
performance_metrics: Time taken to save the configuration.
API response time for token validation.
Page load time for the RoostGPT Config page.
accessibility_requirements: All interactive elements must be accessible via keyboard navigation.
Labels for input fields must be properly associated.
ARIA roles and attributes must be verified for screen reader support.
